## FLANK-ARCH-001 — cross-engine

- **Decision role:** `architectural_invariant`
- **Status:** `implemented`
- **Claim:** Primer design/screening and named bench-protocol authority are separate. A named protocol may carry product-specific cycling/chemistry and, for long-range, may tighten its sequence constraint envelope; proprietary buffer thermodynamics are not reconstructed.
- **Sources:** https://primer3.org/manual.html
- **Implementation:** `tools/src/pcr_tools/pipeline.py`, `tools/src/pcr_tools/presets.py`, `web/src/components/design/design-result.tsx`, `web/src/components/design/result-view.tsx`
- **Claim boundary:** No sequence-only result establishes yield, efficiency, sensitivity or a universal annealing programme.

## FLANK-SPEC-001 — species-specific-pcr

- **Decision role:** `fail_closed_panel_exclusivity`
- **Status:** `implemented`
- **Claim:** Every executable species-specific request requires separate inclusivity/exclusion evidence and canonical per-record accession.version, role and topology. Linear/circular/fragment scanning, across-origin circular matching, canonical snapshot hashing, duplicate/version checks and finite-panel surveillance diff are implemented; finite-panel evidence is never promoted to whole-database or population completeness.
